searchHotels.description: Build a Booking.com searchresults URL (city, dates, party, star classes, review floor, currency, popularity order), open it in a NEW BACKGROUND target, poll until [data-testid=property-card] cards render and the count stops changing, read the first `limit` cards and close the target. Works logged out. priceTotal is the whole stay for the room, not per night.

minStars.description: star classes to keep, default [3,4]; one class=N filter each (an exact-class list, not a floor)

minReview.description: minimum review score, default 8 (sent as review_score=80); 0 disables

returns.description: {url, hotels:[{name, priceTotal (number, whole stay), priceText, score (number), reviews (number)}], summary:{count, median, cheapest:[{name, priceTotal} x3]}}; {stop:"no-results", hint, url} when no card rendered
